statement: Flat local base change from a Noetherian henselian local ring with unchanged residue preserves and reflects representation isomorphism indecomposability form types and actual isometry
notes: Full actual Hom base change gives identical residue matrix images. Their kernels lie in radicals even over the non-Noetherian target. Source semiperfectness proves local endomorphism rings; source hermitian lifting reflects actual isometry. No target Noetherian or lifting assumption.

statement: Computable flat local unions of solved henselian stages with fixed effective residue have complete ordinary canonical rational Om and split WG algorithms with injective transition maps
notes: All finite coefficient data and exact identities descend to one stage. Injective flat transitions make common-stage equality and kernels exact. Reflected isometry and indecomposability make all positive decisions stable. Least finite codes give literal canonical indices. Cancellative stage form monoids yield the injective group colimit; every requested operation is finite.

statement: The ordinary classification covers h and sh of countably infinite polynomial local rings over finite fields and integers at finite odd residue points
depends_on: C:effective-henselian-flat-unions; C:henselian-products-WG; Stacks10.155.8 and12; Stacks15.46.1 and6 and10
notes: Pointed h/sh polynomial-stage maps are flat with common residue. Universal properties identify their union with the displayed h/sh ring. Stage regularity and preserved cotangent bases give countable local domains of infinite embedding and Krull dimension. Infinite compact groups are uncountable so these rings are not profinite.
